metadata.title: Product Bricks & Capabilities
metadata.description: Three-level product brick map for the enterprise-architecture-management-platform domain.

rootGroups.name: Architecture Knowledge Graph
rootGroups.description: Model the enterprise as connected capabilities, applications, technologies, processes, data, people, and initiatives.

subGroups.name: Data Intake and Metamodel
subGroups.description: Define how architecture data is structured, imported, synchronized, and governed as a living graph.

bricks.name: Configurable Metamodel Studio
bricks.description: No-code metamodel, object type, relation, attribute, lifecycle, and viewpoint configuration for each customer's architecture practice.

internalModules.title: Metamodel configuration service
internalModules.description: Versioned schema and rule engine for object types, relationship types, attributes, and validation policies.

interfaces.title: Metamodel Admin API
interfaces.description: Programmatic interface for schema, relation, and validation configuration.

dataDependencies.description: Controls which architecture objects and relationships can exist.

bricks.name: Architecture Repository
bricks.description: Tenant-isolated graph repository for architecture objects, relationships, versions, and evidence references.

internalModules.title: Graph persistence service
internalModules.description: Stores and retrieves object and relationship graphs at enterprise scale.

interfaces.title: Architecture Graph API
interfaces.description: Query and mutation API for architecture graph content.

dataDependencies.description: Stores canonical architecture objects.
Stores canonical architecture relationships.

bricks.name: Bulk Import and Mapping Workbench
bricks.description: Spreadsheet, CSV, repository, and API import tools that map source fields into the architecture metamodel with validation feedback.

internalModules.title: Import mapping engine
internalModules.description: Maps incoming source data to configured metamodel objects, relationships, and attributes.

interfaces.title: Import Workbench UI
interfaces.description: User interface for mapping source fields, validating imports, and resolving exceptions.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Spreadsheets, CMDB exports, modeling repositories, and CSV files
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provide initial portfolio and architecture data.

dataDependencies.description: Publishes import quality, error, and completion events.

bricks.name: Source System Synchronization
bricks.description: Scheduled and event-driven connectors for ITSM, CMDB, SPM, cloud, security, ERP, HR, and finance systems.

internalModules.title: Connector orchestration service
internalModules.description: Runs incremental syncs, handles retries, and preserves source lineage.

interfaces.title: Connector Configuration API
interfaces.description: Manage source connections, schedules, credentials, and field mappings.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: ServiceNow, Jira, Azure, AWS, SAP, Microsoft 365, identity, and finance systems
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provide operating data used to keep architecture models current.

dataDependencies.description: Publishes connector freshness and mapping drift events.

subGroups.name: Core Architecture Objects
subGroups.description: Represent the enterprise objects that connect strategy, business operation, applications, technologies, and processes.

bricks.name: Business Capability Model

internalModules.title: Capability modeling service

interfaces.title: Capability Map Workspace
interfaces.description: Visual and tabular capability modeling surface.

dataDependencies.description: Maintains business capability data.

bricks.description: Application inventory, ownership, lifecycle, criticality, business fit, technical fit, cost, and usage context.

internalModules.title: Application portfolio service

interfaces.title: Application Portfolio API
interfaces.description: Portfolio query and update interface for applications and assessments.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: CMDB, SaaS management, procurement, and finance systems
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provide application records, spend, usage, and ownership signals.

dataDependencies.description: Maintains application portfolio data.

bricks.description: Technology products, versions, lifecycle states, standards, exceptions, and affected applications or capabilities.

internalModules.title: Technology standards service
internalModules.description: Maintains lifecycle and standard-state information for technologies.

interfaces.title: Technology Standards API
interfaces.description: Access technology standards, lifecycle, and exception data.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Provide technology inventory and lifecycle evidence.

rootGroups.name: Portfolio Intelligence

subGroups.name: Assessment and Rationalization

bricks.name: Application Rationalization Engine

Publishes rationalization decisions and evidence.
